artboards.title: The dial — now, at rest, changing
Project plan — the Gantt gets the page
Roadmap — every project on one axis

annotations.text:
AI team, projects module. Reference status-report layout in the app's own tokens — Archivo, electric palette, 20px panels, the .micro/.fig ramp. Dark shown; light inverts through the same tokens.

Built: the dials, the milestone Gantt, the plain-word labels.

Three fixes: the project page was too long, the plan page was thin, and managers had nowhere to see every project at once.

The roadmap is one row per project — not tasks — and the same block goes on a portfolio status report.
